test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 17 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets.

This government was (feeble) ___________ and corrupt.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Robust**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Feeble"** means weak, lacking physical strength or vigor, often due to age or illness. (कमज़ोर)

 
 
• **Example: **After recovering from the illness, he still felt feeble and needed rest.
 
 
 
• **"Robust"** refers to something strong and healthy, full of vigor, and able to withstand challenges. (मज़बूत)
 
 
• **Example: **The robust economy was able to recover quickly after the recession.
 
 
 
• Since "robust" is the direct antonym of "feeble," it is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Robust**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vulnerable** (संवेदनशील): Exposed to the possibility of being harmed or attacked.

 
 
• **Example:** The fortress was vulnerable to enemy attacks due to its poor defenses.
 
 
 
• **Spindly** (पतला-दुबला): Thin and weak in appearance, lacking strength.
 
 
• **Example:** The spindly branches of the tree bent under the weight of the snow.
 
 
 
• **Bungling** (अक्षम): Clumsy or incompetent in handling tasks.
 
 
• **Example:** His bungling efforts to fix the machine only made the problem worse.
